title: Grateful Dead Live at Market Square Arena on 1981-12-05
lineage: D5 > Edirol UA5 custom Oade mod > USB > IBM R40 > Soundforge > WAV > CDR > EAC > WinXP Pro > Flac Frontend > FLAC16

ai_review.summary: Natural sound with a slightly distant, boomy character, but the band mix is perfect.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers a pleasant natural ambience, though it sits a bit far back and can feel boomy at times. The overall balance of the band is spot‑on, making it an enjoyable listen despite the minor tonal quirks. No specific performance issues were noted in the review.

ai_rating.rationale: Single 4‑star review highlights solid musical performance and a decent recording with minor tonal issues, leading to an overall good rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Natural sound praised; noted as slightly distant and boomy, but band mix is perfect and no major flaws reported.
